subpages.title: À propos : CELERIS Informatique
subpages.desc: Découvrez notre histoire et nos valeurs. Chez CELERIS, nous misons sur des relations de confiance, durables et authentiques. Notre priorité est d’apporter notre expertise et notre indépendance pour répondre aux besoins uniques de chaque client.
subpages.text: Our services Techcenter News They trust us About us ​ 0 Follow us ​ ​ English English Français Sign in Contact Us ​ 0 Our services Techcenter News They trust us About us Follow us ​ ​ Sign in English English Français Contact Us DISCOVER OUR STORY AND OUR VALUES DISCOVER OUR STORY AND OUR VALUES A COMMON VISION Simon Pierre Mathieu Founder of LOGISTORE in 1993, specializing in end-of-line distribution for major manufacturers. After building a team of 80 people and generating €60M in revenue, he sold LOGISTORE in 2005 to embark on an ambitious new project: CELERIS Informatique. Raphaël Maurice After several years of sales experience in France and England, he joined LOGISTORE in 2003. In 2010, they founded CELERIS Informatique with an innovative concept: supporting each client independently from manufacturers, with an ‘all-included’ service. Erwan Quimbert At the beginning of 2014, with 15 years of experience in system integration, EQ joined the team as Technical Director and became a shareholder. OUR PHILOSOPHY At CELERIS, we focus on building trust-based, long-lasting, and authentic relationships. Our priority is to bring our expertise and independence to meet the unique needs of every client. Raphaël Maurice ​ • CTO of CELERIS Informatique ​ NOTRE ACTION SOLIDAIRE CELERIS Informatique soutient Première Urgence Internationale, une association humanitaire française présente au plus près des populations touchées par la guerre et les crises.Présente jusqu’au « dernier kilomètre », elle apporte une aide concrète sur le terrain.Nous sommes fiers de contribuer, à notre échelle, à cette mission de solidarité, et invitons nos clients, partenaires et notre réseau à découvrir leur engagement et, s’ils le souhaitent, à les soutenir à leur tour. OUR APPROACH​ Our approach is based on a constant focus on performance, sustainability, and innovation to ensure our clients’ competitiveness today and tomorrow. We are passionate about technological innovation and anticipating market trends. Through continuous monitoring of market developments, we strive to identify the most innovative and cost-effective technologies, enabling our clients to make informed and strategic decisions. OPTIMIZED OFFER Transparent offers at a fair price : We compare what is truly comparable to provide you with well-considered purchases. Thanks to our knowledge of manufacturers, we put the best offers in competition to guarantee an optimal quality-price ratio, perfectly aligned with your needs. BESPOKE SERVICES Comprehensive management : mastering, kitting, integration, and delivery, including international shipping . Each piece of equipment is custom-configured and ready to use. We only store what is intended for your projects, ensuring optimized logistics and flawless deployment. FOLLOW UP Personalized support: We stay by your side after delivery to adjust your solutions to your evolving needs.
